summary: An on-site internship in Indore, building backends for an AI hiring-automation product.
work: Built async AI workflow backends in Python and FastAPI using PostgreSQL, Redis Streams and background workers, containerised with Docker for reliable task execution.
Integrated multiple LLM providers (Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter) with automatic fallback, retry handling and schema-validated structured outputs.
Contributed to an AI hiring-automation platform: resume parsing, candidate profiling, Qdrant-based semantic matching, automated screening and interview workflows.
